NOTES:
1. Raw (Classic) records began Nov 2011.
2. Only lifts in PAP-recognized raw events are considered.
3. Raw lifts in non-raw competitions (including PAP events) are not considered.
4. Sub-Junior lifters are allowed to break Junior records (IPF rule).
5. Master 4 lifters are allowed to break Master 1,2,3 records (IPF rule).
6. Master 3 lifters are allowed to break Master 1,2 records (IPF rule).
7. Master 2 lifters are allowed to break Master 1 records (IPF rule).
8. Lifters who get a postive result in anti-doping tests will forfeit all records from Jan 1, 2011 up to the date of the positive test result.
9. Only PAP-registered team names will be mentioned.
